description: This file defines an abstract class 'Extension' used in the OpenMRS project to represent extension points in the user interface. It includes properties such as pointId, moduleId, parameters, media type, and methods for initialization, extension identification, and content override.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: An abstract base class representing a UI extension point in OpenMRS, supporting initialization, media types, ordering, and extension identification.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the extension with parameters and logs the initialization process.

methods.name: getParameterMap
methods.description: Returns the parameters associated with the extension point.

methods.name: setParameterMap
methods.description: Sets the parameters for the extension point.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the media type that this extension supports.

methods.name: getExtensionId
methods.description: Constructs and returns the unique extension identifier based on pointId and mediaType.

methods.name: getOverrideContent
methods.description: Allows overriding default content for this extension; by default returns null.

methods.name: getModuleId
methods.description: Returns the module identifier associated with this extension.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order in which this extension should be displayed relative to other extensions; default is 0.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the extension object.
